sections.value:
## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #219 at **0a693ca73abf7a81cb3cd3f6f63d70978ddd3e83**, under C33/C34. Reviewed the 12-file delta and directly relevant transport/caller helpers. No demonstrated replay of a daemon-read write or blocking security vulnerability identified.

| Transport | Refusal-only boundary |
|---|---|
| Rust | `crates/cli/src/client.rs:564-600,631-650,843-857` retries send failures with a typed `io::ErrorKind::ConnectionRefused` in the source chain, not string matching. HTTP responses return immediately; response-body decoding is outside retry. Non-cloneable streamed bodies are sent once. |
| OMP/router TS | `.omp/extensions/pij/adapters/daemon-http.ts:449-518,635-645` recognizes refusal transport codes through bounded cause traversal. Response decoding is outside the loop. The pre-existing 401/403 credential-refresh resend is separate. Router retry surrounds its health probe, not the routed write. |
| Copilot JS | `.copilot/extensions/pij/store.mjs:464-474,564-625` recognizes nested ECONNREFUSED, or a nonempty aggregate whose members all carry that code. Only fetch is retried; body/envelope handling follows outside it. |

These are transport-code checks, not explicit connection-phase predicates. Resets, timeouts and HTTP refusals do not enter the added refusal-retry branch. Request bodies are reused without new shell expansion/evaluation.

The real loopback regression `a_request_the_daemon_read_is_never_sent_again` reads a write and closes without answering, then asserts one accepted connection over 1.5 seconds (`client.rs:996-1022`). TS/native reset cases assert fetch counts; they are not independent server-receipt proof for every failure.

### Named notes and contract limits

**S219-N001: OMP post-cancel continuation.** `pij_send` and `pij_spawn` discard the supplied `_signal` and do not pass it through runtime send/spawn (`.omp/extensions/pij/index.ts:184-205,348-362`). Without it, refusal backoff sleeps on an unrelated signal and can fetch again after tool cancellation if the host remains alive (`adapters/daemon-http.ts:495-518`). PM accepted this as nonblocking: it requires the bounce/cancel overlap and sends the originally requested write. Plumb the signal and add an abort-during-backoff case as a cheap round-2/follow-up repair. No blanket “no writes after cancellation” assurance is made; host teardown behavior was not independently established.

**S219-N002: override scope.** `PIJ_RS_RESTART_WAIT_MS` applies to Rust CLI and the router, including zero for immediate refusal, as the API documentation explicitly says. Extension retry clients do not consume it; do not describe it as a fleet-wide override.

**S219-N003: fast-path scope.** Rust excludes its listed interactive/hook/runtime fast paths (`crates/cli/src/main.rs:1384-1388,2505-2534`). Router health probes select waiting by route, not every Rust command-specific exemption. OMP adds retry to send/spawn only; Copilot to send only. Stream/inbox/registration routes remain outside the added retry. No uniform fast-path or host-wide cancellation contract is claimed.

**S219-N004: rendering qualification.** Copilot's restart banner uses fixed safe text; generated router envelopes use JSON serialization. Rust human refusal metadata is not `caller_text`-escaped; new addresses originate in trusted local configuration. No new external attacker-controlled injection path was established, but universal terminal-safe rendering is not proven.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No blocking security vulnerability demonstrated in scoped changes | - |

**CI proof:** clean detached worktree HEAD and GitHub/remote heads agree; GitHub reports CLEAN and successful current checks. Run [42764036542](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42764036542) checked merge `d119d0f171cd1f26a85d0d79d0cea7d804ed68b4`, with parents main `765e3320bb524701ddc3bce9db7c5c11bf060165` and this exact head. Rust reports **2,416 passed, 6 skipped**. Successful artifact `13739600549` explicitly lists the daemon-read/no-resend regression as passed. Node 22 reports 2,287 passed/6 skipped; native tests report 350 passed, including refused recovery, exhausted wait and reset/no-resend cases.

Static source review and existing CI only. No local builds/tests, real network/process probes, config/credential reads or product mutations. Cost/after-deploy measurements remain the performance verdict's scope.
